verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a true multi-item write is the MCP tool fireflies_move_meeting, which moves meetings to a channel or folder but caps out at 5 per call. fireflies_share_meeting fans one meeting out to up to 100 recipients, which is not a bulk operation across many items. Listing many transcripts via the transcripts query and asking AskFred across meetings are reads, not bulk operations. Missing for 10: bulk operations across large item sets, bulk delete/update/tag via the GraphQL API, batch upload support, documented limits and error handling for batch actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
